originality.rationale: The general finite cross-covariance is already recoverable from Mahmoud and Smythe (2012), particularly Proposition 1, and is not asserted original. The examined text did not state the global strict one-switch sign classification for all positive multiplicities, absence of zero covariances, monotone packet-width phase transitions, or a concrete reversal. This is a qualitative structural theorem beyond the raw covariance equation, although earlier implicit deductions remain a real priority risk.
residual_risks: Mahmoud–Smythe Proposition 1 provides mathematically broader raw covariance coverage. The classification could be considered an implicit algebraic corollary or could have been extracted elsewhere.

value.rationale: The theorem gives an all-parameter, all-positive-frequency strict covariance sign diagram and an exact packet-size reversal mechanism for a standard fixed-size-without-replacement coupon sampling model. It identifies which frequency classes move with or against the unobserved population, including proof that no arithmetic tie can occur. The value is the natural global qualitative classification, not rederivation of the already known covariance recurrence.
